reason: My register has never let me down, and I count the drawer myself every night, so I already know my takings. Making my girls take selfies and type numbers on their phones between customers just adds work, and many of my customers won't give their mobile number anyway.
objection: Half my ladies don't want to give their number, and without the number the reminders, wallet and WhatsApp bill are useless. Then I am paying ₹999 every month for something my register already does for free.
would_change_my_mind: If another salon owner near me showed me it actually brought customers back and caught money going missing, and it worked even for customers who don't give a number, with no setup fee so I could just try it.
